scope: References and selected JUnit outcomes only; mixed test files can include other operators. Counts overlap across entries. No certification of all shapes, dtypes, variants, public APIs or performance.

entries.name: GQAPagedFwdOp
known_gaps: General FP16/BF16 programs have selected RoPE/window/sink and split numerical coverage; public dispatch and WS RoPE preparation are unvalidated
Upstream paged GQA still requires an external implementation for FP8

entries.name: MLADecodeWithKVCacheFwdOp
known_gaps: WS variant calls unsupported tileops::uniform_wgmma_bases; MMA numerics are tested

entries.name: SigmoidFwdOp
known_gaps: FP32 generic-load numerics are tested; aligned register-copy uses CUDA-only tileops::load16_evict_last
FP16/BF16 sigmoid uses unsupported CUDA __fdividef, including the generic-load path

entries.name: GemmW4A16FwdOp
known_gaps: WGMMA variant calls unsupported tileops::w4a16_dequant_word; original MMA FP16/BF16 numerics are tested

entries.name: DeltaNetFwdOp
known_gaps: Inference decode FP16/BF16 numerics are tested; full inference prefill/varlen composition is not validated

entries.name: KDAFwdOp
known_gaps: Decode FP16/BF16 numerics are tested; default 256-thread chunk-prefill overflows the host stack and 32-thread prepare/scan has incorrect numerics

entries.name: MoEGroupedGemmFP8FwdOp
known_gaps: Minimal original-kernel probe fails TIR opaque-access region inference before codegen; source also uses SM90 TMA/WGMMA and tileops::moe_fp8 helpers

entries.name: RMSNormFwdOp
known_gaps: Ragged FP32 width uses the original generic-load path; aligned/warp-row vector fast paths call tileops::load16_evict_last

entries.name: INT8QuantPerTensorFwdOp
known_gaps: Whole vectors require tileops::load16 helpers; multiple CTAs also require grid-wide synchronization

entries.name: INT8QuantPerChannelFwdOp
known_gaps: Whole vectors require tileops::load16 helpers; only short scalar-tail probes have run

entries.name: INT8QuantPerBlockFwdOp
known_gaps: Whole vectors require tileops::load16_evict_first; only short scalar-tail probes have run

entries.name: INT4QuantPerGroupFwdOp
known_gaps: First blocker is uint32-to-float16x2 reinterpret; also requires CUDA-specific tileops::load16 helpers

entries.name: SmoothQuantFwdOp
known_gaps: Whole vectors require tileops::load16 helpers

entries.name: INT8DequantPerTensorFwdOp
known_gaps: Calls CUDA-specific tileops::load_f32_evict_last

entries.name: FP8QuantPerBlockFwdOp
known_gaps: Unaligned FP16/BF16/FP32 numerics are tested; aligned variant requires tileops::load16 helpers

entries.name: SoftmaxFwdOp
known_gaps: Ragged 513-column FP32 row uses generic loads; aligned held-row fast path calls tileops::load16_evict_last

entries.name: TopKMaskFwdOp
known_gaps: Numerics cover FP32 scalar loads; packed 16-bit and clustered variants are not validated

entries.name: TopPMaskFwdOp
known_gaps: Numerics cover FP32 scalar loads and one CTA per row; multi-CTA grid synchronization is not supported

entries.name: TopKTopPMaskFwdOp
known_gaps: Numerics cover FP32 scalar loads; packed 16-bit and clustered variants are not validated

entries.name: SamplingFromProbsFwdOp
known_gaps: Numerics cover scalar loads and one CTA per row; vector loads and split-row grid synchronization remain unvalidated

entries.name: ChainSpeculativeSamplingFwdOp
known_gaps: Numerics cover scalar loads and one CTA per row; vector loads and split-row grid synchronization remain unvalidated
